concept.title: Bring in, share and keep safe
concept.shortdesc: What your workspace holds, why a GEDZIP file is the one to keep and send, and when a plain family tree file is better.

conbody.p: Your tree is more than one file. It is the family tree, its research notes, and the pictures and other files you attach. This chapter says what does with a file you open, how to keep a copy safe, and which file to send.
The short answer is the GEDZIP file. It holds your whole workspace in one file. Keep your work in a GEDZIP file, and send a GEDZIP file to anyone who also uses .
A plain family tree file is for older programs only. It leaves out your pictures and other attached files.
Your tree may have started in another program. Your family may want a copy. This chapter is for both.
